A0027.title: Customer Service Follow-Up Confirmation
A0027.definition: Using customer service phone follow-ups and similar methods to confirm user authenticity or the legitimacy of their actions.
A0027.description: In certain specialized business scenarios (such as financial scenarios), when the system identifies abnormal user behavior during the handling process, customer service phone follow-ups can be combined to notify users or verify user legitimacy.
A0027.limitation: Customer-service callbacks are expensive and usually limited to major risks. Attackers may bypass confirmation by controlling the contact number, coaching the victim, or impersonating the account holder, while missed calls, unclear responses, and reviewer judgment errors can produce false positives and false negatives.

references.title: Digital Identity Guidelines: Authentication and Lifecycle Management - NIST SP 800-63B
